verses.ar: «أَنَا ٱلْكَرْمَةُ ٱلْحَقِيقِيَّةُ وَأَبِي ٱلْكَرَّامُ.
verses.kjv: I am the true vine, and my Father is the husbandman.
verses.web: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

verses.ar: كُلُّ غُصْنٍ فِيَّ لَا يَأْتِي بِثَمَرٍ يَنْزِعُهُ، وَكُلُّ مَا يَأْتِي بِثَمَرٍ يُنَقِّيهِ لِيَأْتِيَ بِثَمَرٍ أَكْثَرَ.
verses.kjv: Every branch in me that beareth not fruit he taketh away: and every [branch] that beareth fruit, he purgeth it, that it may bring forth more fruit.
verses.web: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

verses.ar: أَنْتُمُ ٱلْآنَ أَنْقِيَاءُ لِسَبَبِ ٱلْكَلَامِ ٱلَّذِي كَلَّمْتُكُمْ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: Now ye are clean through the word which I have spoken unto you.
verses.web: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

verses.ar: اُثْبُتُوا فِيَّ وَأَنَا فِيكُمْ. كَمَا أَنَّ ٱلْغُصْنَ لَا يَقْدِرُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ بِثَمَرٍ مِنْ ذَاتِهِ إِنْ لَمْ يَثْبُتْ فِي ٱلْكَرْمَةِ، كَذَلِكَ أَنْتُمْ أَيْضًا إِنْ لَمْ تَثْبُتُوا فِيَّ.
verses.kjv: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can ye, except ye abide in me.
verses.web: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

verses.ar: أَنَا ٱلْكَرْمَةُ وَأَنْتُمُ ٱلْأَغْصَانُ. ٱلَّذِي يَثْبُتُ فِيَّ وَأَنَا فِيهِ هَذَا يَأْتِي بِثَمَرٍ كَثِيرٍ، لِأَنَّكُمْ بِدُونِي لَا تَقْدِرُونَ أَنْ تَفْعَلُوا شَيْئًا.
verses.kjv: I am the vine, ye [are] the branches: He that abideth in me, and I in him, the same bringeth forth much fruit: for without me ye can do nothing.
verses.web: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

verses.ar: إِنْ كَانَ أَحَدٌ لَا يَثْبُتُ فِيَّ يُطْرَحُ خَارِجًا كَٱلْغُصْنِ، فَيَجِفُّ وَيَجْمَعُونَهُ وَيَطْرَحُونَهُ فِي ٱلنَّارِ، فَيَحْتَرِقُ.
verses.kjv: If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast [them] into the fire, and they are burned.
verses.web: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

verses.ar: إِنْ ثَبَتُّمْ فِيَّ وَثَبَتَ كَلَامِي فِيكُمْ تَطْلُبُونَ مَا تُرِيدُونَ فَيَكُونُ لَكُمْ.
verses.kjv: If ye abide in me, and my words abide in you, ye shall ask what ye will, and it shall be done unto you.
verses.web: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

verses.ar: بِهَذَا يَتَمَجَّدُ أَبِي: أَنْ تَأْتُوا بِثَمَرٍ كَثِيرٍ فَتَكُونُونَ تَلَامِيذِي.
verses.kjv: Herein is my Father glorified, that ye bear much fruit; so shall ye be my disciples.
verses.web: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

verses.ar: كَمَا أَحَبَّنِي ٱلْآبُ كَذَلِكَ أَحْبَبْتُكُمْ أَنَا. اُثْبُتُوا فِي مَحَبَّتِي.
verses.kjv: As the Father hath loved me, so have I loved you: continue ye in my love.
verses.web: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

verses.ar: إِنْ حَفِظْتُمْ وَصَايَايَ تَثْبُتُونَ فِي مَحَبَّتِي، كَمَا أَنِّي أَنَا قَدْ حَفِظْتُ وَصَايَا أَبِي وَأَثْبُتُ فِي مَحَبَّتِهِ.
verses.kjv: If ye keep my commandments, ye shall abide in my love; even as I have kept my Father’s commandments, and abide in his love.
verses.web: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

verses.ar: كَلَّمْتُكُمْ بِهَذَا لِكَيْ يَثْبُتَ فَرَحِي فِيكُمْ وَيُكْمَلَ فَرَحُكُمْ.
verses.kjv: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and [that] your joy might be full.
verses.web: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

verses.ar: «هَذِهِ هِيَ وَصِيَّتِي أَنْ تُحِبُّوا بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا كَمَا أَحْبَبْتُكُمْ.
verses.kjv: This is my commandment, That ye love one another, as I have loved you.
verses.web: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

verses.ar: لَيْسَ لِأَحَدٍ حُبٌّ أَعْظَمُ مِنْ هَذَا: أَنْ يَضَعَ أَحَدٌ نَفْسَهُ لِأَجْلِ أَحِبَّائِهِ.
verses.kjv: Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.web: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

verses.ar: أَنْتُمْ أَحِبَّائِي إِنْ فَعَلْتُمْ مَا أُوصِيكُمْ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: Ye are my friends, if ye do whatsoever I command you.
verses.web: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

verses.ar: لَا أَعُودُ أُسَمِّيكُمْ عَبِيدًا، لِأَنَّ ٱلْعَبْدَ لَا يَعْلَمُ مَا يَعْمَلُ سَيِّدُهُ، لَكِنِّي قَدْ سَمَّيْتُكُمْ أَحِبَّاءَ لِأَنِّي أَعْلَمْتُكُمْ بِكُلِّ مَا سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ أَبِي.
verses.kjv: Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knoweth not what his lord doeth: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you.
verses.web: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

verses.ar: لَيْسَ أَنْتُمُ ٱخْتَرْتُمُونِي بَلْ أَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكُمْ، وَأَقَمْتُكُمْ لِتَذْهَبُوا وَتَأْتُوا بِثَمَرٍ، وَيَدُومَ ثَمَرُكُمْ، لِكَيْ يُعْطِيَكُمُ ٱلْآبُ كُلَّ مَا طَلَبْتُمْ بِٱسْمِي.
verses.kjv: Ye have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that ye should go and bring forth fruit, and [that] your fruit should remain: that whatsoever ye shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you.
verses.web: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

verses.ar: بِهَذَا أُوصِيكُمْ حَتَّى تُحِبُّوا بَعْضُكُمْ بَعْضًا.
verses.kjv: These things I command you, that ye love one another.
verses.web: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

verses.ar: «إِنْ كَانَ ٱلْعَالَمُ يُبْغِضُكُمْ فَٱعْلَمُوا أَنَّهُ قَدْ أَبْغَضَنِي قَبْلَكُمْ.
verses.kjv: If the world hate you, ye know that it hated me before [it hated] you.
verses.web: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

verses.ar: لَوْ كُنْتُمْ مِنَ ٱلْعَالَمِ لَكَانَ ٱلْعَالَمُ يُحِبُّ خَاصَّتَهُ. وَلَكِنْ لِأَنَّكُمْ لَسْتُمْ مِنَ ٱلْعَالَمِ، بَلْ أَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكُمْ مِنَ ٱلْعَالَمِ، لِذَلِكَ يُبْغِضُكُمُ ٱلْعَالَمُ.
verses.kjv: If ye were of the world, the world would love his own: but because ye are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hateth you.
verses.web: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

verses.ar: اُذْكُرُوا ٱلْكَلَامَ ٱلَّذِي قُلْتُهُ لَكُمْ: لَيْسَ عَبْدٌ أَعْظَمَ مِنْ سَيِّدِهِ. إِنْ كَانُوا قَدِ ٱضْطَهَدُونِي فَسَيَضْطَهِدُونَكُمْ، وَإِنْ كَانُوا قَدْ حَفِظُوا كَلَامِي فَسَيَحْفَظُونَ كَلَامَكُمْ.
verses.kjv: Remember the word that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, they will keep yours also.
verses.web: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

verses.ar: لَكِنَّهُمْ إِنَّمَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِكُمْ هَذَا كُلَّهُ مِنْ أَجْلِ ٱسْمِي، لِأَنَّهُمْ لَا يَعْرِفُونَ ٱلَّذِي أَرْسَلَنِي.
verses.kjv: But all these things will they do unto you for my name’s sake, because they know not him that sent me.
verses.web: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

verses.ar: لَوْ لَمْ أَكُنْ قَدْ جِئْتُ وَكَلَّمْتُهُمْ، لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُمْ خَطِيَّةٌ، وَأَمَّا ٱلْآنَ فَلَيْسَ لَهُمْ عُذْرٌ فِي خَطِيَّتِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloke for their sin.
verses.web: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

verses.ar: اَلَّذِي يُبْغِضُنِي يُبْغِضُ أَبِي أَيْضًا.
verses.kjv: He that hateth me hateth my Father also.
verses.web: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

verses.ar: لَوْ لَمْ أَكُنْ قَدْ عَمِلْتُ بَيْنَهُمْ أَعْمَالًا لَمْ يَعْمَلْهَا أَحَدٌ غَيْرِي، لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُمْ خَطِيَّةٌ، وَأَمَّا ٱلْآنَ فَقَدْ رَأَوْا وَأَبْغَضُونِي أَنَا وَأَبِي.
verses.kjv: If I had not done among them the works which none other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.web: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

verses.ar: لَكِنْ لِكَيْ تَتِمَّ ٱلْكَلِمَةُ ٱلْمَكْتُوبَةُ فِي نَامُوسِهِمْ: إِنَّهُمْ أَبْغَضُونِي بِلَا سَبَبٍ.
verses.kjv: But [this cometh to pass], that the word might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause.
verses.web: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

verses.ar: «وَمَتَى جَاءَ ٱلْمُعَزِّي ٱلَّذِي سَأُرْسِلُهُ أَنَا إِلَيْكُمْ مِنَ ٱلْآبِ، رُوحُ ٱلْحَقِّ، ٱلَّذِي مِنْ عِنْدِ ٱلْآبِ يَنْبَثِقُ، فَهُوَ يَشْهَدُ لِي.
verses.kjv: But when the Comforter is come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, [even] the Spirit of truth, which proceedeth from the Father, he shall testify of me:
verses.web: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

verses.ar: وَتَشْهَدُونَ أَنْتُمْ أَيْضًا لِأَنَّكُمْ مَعِي مِنَ ٱلِٱبْتِدَاءِ.
verses.kjv: And ye also shall bear witness, because ye have been with me from the beginning.
verses.web: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.
